description: This file declares internal functions related to the fused AdamW optimizer implementation optimized for Apple’s Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It defines two overloads of the function '_fused_adamw_amsgrad_mps_impl_', which are used to perform parameter updates with options for different parameter types.

methods.name: _fused_adamw_amsgrad_mps_impl_ (TensorList version)
methods.description: Declares a function for performing the fused AdamW with AMSGrad optimizer step on a list of tensors, without scalar learning rate parameters, suitable for batched parameter updates.

methods.name: _fused_adamw_amsgrad_mps_impl_ (Tensor reference version)
methods.description: Declares a function for performing the fused AdamW with AMSGrad optimizer step on tensors, with learning rate provided as a tensor, suitable for per-parameter adaptive learning rate scenarios.
